# PDF.js 6.3.289

Unmodified browser library and matching worker, CMaps, standard fonts, ICC profiles,
and WebAssembly assets from the official Mozilla `pdfjs-dist` npm package.
Downloaded 2026-09-09; Apache-2.0 license included, with asset-specific licenses in their directories.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.3.289.tgz
Verified npm integrity: `sha512-ZHjSVpDa3D6izMq8/04lvkhkATUmL9px6ChPaXc1k6nU2Mrhlg1/7F0bdUqCwUjw3NsPTfPZsMDUU6ZIcRaeQw==`

The viewer is loaded only for PDF resume verification. All runtime assets are served
by Soro. Private document bytes go only from existing private storage to the authorized
reviewer's browser; no document URLs are forwarded to a third-party viewer.
